figures_and_tables_checked.label: Figure 1
figures_and_tables_checked.review: Conceptual task, acquisition burden and claimed contrast-free benefits; not a measured clinical or economic comparison.

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Figure 2
figures_and_tables_checked.review: Illustrative spatial distortion and temporal discontinuities; no numerical axes, sample denominator or failure rate.

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Figure 3
figures_and_tables_checked.review: Training/inference, LAL and LDL architecture. Requested clinical time is distinct from diffusion time; lower-panel lettering and p/q meanings are inconsistent or unclear.

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Table 1
figures_and_tables_checked.review: All eight method/ablation rows and both dataset metric groups transcribed. CCNet has higher PSNR; MRI CEKWorld leads the other reported dataset-specific metrics. No statistical uncertainty or evaluation denominator.

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Figure 4
figures_and_tables_checked.review: Selected abdominal time sequence, 6–190 s; qualitative image/kinetics comparison, not horizon-resolved error.

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Figure 5
figures_and_tables_checked.review: Selected breast images at 261, 363 and 462 s; no quantitative kinetic error or diagnostic endpoint.

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Figure 6
figures_and_tables_checked.review: Normalized generated renal ROI curves in arterial, venous and delayed windows. No ground-truth curve, numbered vertical scale or uncertainty.

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Figure 7
figures_and_tables_checked.review: λSpatial and Ki ablations. Ki=0 is plotted despite Ki≥1 in the main definition; validation-set selection and run variability are not reported.

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Figure 8
figures_and_tables_checked.review: PCA latent scatter plots and early-time outliers. Time-color prose conflicts; shared PCA basis and quantitative continuity statistics are not specified.

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Supplementary Material
figures_and_tables_checked.review: Embedded supplement, not a separately retrieved file; all supplied text and image-review notes included.

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Supplementary Section 6: The Derivation of Dense Smooth Constraint
figures_and_tables_checked.review: Taylor expansion and Equation (5); sign discrepancy, weighting and nonuniform-grid accuracy claims queued.

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Supplementary Section 7: The Details of Experiments
figures_and_tables_checked.review: Additional acquisition/scanner information and selected qualitative comparisons.

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Supplementary Section 7.1: Datasets
figures_and_tables_checked.review: Abdominal phase windows and registration; breast scanner manufacturers, field strengths and cited median interval.

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Supplementary Section 7.2: Visualization Results
figures_and_tables_checked.review: Qualitative visualization analyses; no new quantitative clinical validation.

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Supplementary Section 7.2.1: Visualization of Different Tissues in Abdominal DCE-MRI
figures_and_tables_checked.review: Spleen, liver and kidney interpretations, with inconsistent narrative/figure times.

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Figure 9
figures_and_tables_checked.review: Spleen montage; labels 6, 9, 11, 14, 16, 37, 43, 46, 48, 51, 54, 74, 128 and 191 s. Author annotations are not independent reader results.

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Figure 10
figures_and_tables_checked.review: Liver montage using the same labeled times as Figure 9; qualitative vascular enhancement timing.

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Figure 11
figures_and_tables_checked.review: Kidney montage; labels 6, 9, 12, 15, 17, 42, 49, 51, 54, 57, 60, 78, 98 and 190 s. No measured renal kinetics or perfusion endpoint.

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Figure 12
figures_and_tables_checked.review: Anatomical-fidelity montage and enlarged crops; labels include 59 and 128 s, distinct from nearby Figure 11 values.

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Supplementary Section 7.2.2: Visualization of Spatial Structures in Abdominal DCE-MRI
figures_and_tables_checked.review: Narrative interpreting Figure 12 on page 15; no segmentation/landmark validation.

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Supplementary Section 7.2.3: Visualization Results for Different Enhancement Patterns in Breast DCE-MRI
figures_and_tables_checked.review: Two selected breast cases; diagnostic implications are proposed, not evaluated.

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Figure 13
figures_and_tables_checked.review: Persistent breast enhancement at 261, 363 and 462 s. Benign/low-risk association is not a reported case-specific pathology label.

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Figure 14
figures_and_tables_checked.review: Breast washout example at 193, 312 and 433 s. Earliest displayed time does not show the complete initial rise; no confirmed diagnostic endpoint.

scope_choices: This is automated API model review, including a skeptical second automated synthesis pass, not independent human verification, replication, or clinical endorsement.

The synthesis directly reviewed the supplied text for all 17 physical pages and used supplied page-image review notes. Actual PDF bitmaps, local files, repositories and datasets were not newly accessed in this response.
The source hash and local availability are inherited from the supplied record; neither was independently recomputed or checked.
Feature assertions are deliberately empty as requested. This package is not a completed 128-feature annotation or a completed semantic-validation pass.
Functional L1 future-image prediction does not by itself establish the persistent-state requirement for verified core-WM membership.

The complete inference formulation is baseline image plus requested time. No reusable clinical-state recurrence, measured re-assimilation, settable intervention input, alternative-action comparison, or planner is demonstrated.
Clinical time, diffusion denoising time, optimization epochs, and the two training stages are different coordinates.
Actual clinical imaging datasets are used, but split unit, allocation counts, patient/examination overlap controls and validation-set model selection are not reported. R2 remains unresolved.
The 922 breast examination records must not be equated with 922 unique patients; abdominal and breast counts must not be pooled as a single patient denominator.
Detailed eligibility, demographic distribution, diagnoses, acquisition-site count and subgroup evaluation are not reported.
Registered abdominal images may improve apparent anatomical alignment, but registration algorithm, residual error and quality control are not reported.
Lesion-centered breast cropping uses tumor locations; the availability and source of that localization at the intended noncontrast decision point are not evaluated.
Requested-time generalization is not shown to be patient-independent. The relationship between injection-time and precontrast-image-time origins is unclear.
Virtual intermediate-time predictions are synthetic regularization targets, not acquired dense human ground truth.
Table 1 has no test denominator, confidence intervals, repeated-run variability or statistical tests. Metric-specific time grids and aggregation units are not fully reported.
PSNR units are not explicitly labeled; rMSE evaluation scaling and its relationship to [−1,1] input normalization are insufficiently specified.
cSSIM measures adjacent-frame similarity rather than correct kinetic evolution; it can favor inadequate temporal change and does not normalize for unequal time gaps.
Figure 6 compares normalized generated renal curves without a measured ground-truth curve, numerical vertical scale, sample denominator or uncertainty.
Selected organ and breast montages lack case-selection rules, independent case counts, case-specific pathological confirmation, blinded reader assessment and diagnostic endpoints.
PCA clustering and smooth latent organization do not establish correct physiological dynamics, personalization, or state sufficiency.
Patient conditioning and a patient-specific training template are not proof of personalized predictive value; history/baseline-swap controls are not reported.

LAL uses channel covariance aggregated over spatial locations, which does not uniquely preserve spatial anatomy. Template provenance and mean-covariance versus transformed-vector averaging descriptions are ambiguous.
The purported equidistance objective minimizes squared distances to the template; it does not explicitly equalize distances. Claims about preserved dynamic diversity are not mathematical guarantees.

The supplementary second-difference derivation contains a sign inconsistency and an unrestricted second-order-accuracy claim needing spacing assumptions. The weighted operator is not the ordinary unweighted derivative stencil.
Early-time outlier explanations, Ki=0 versus Ki≥1, figure panel lettering, PCA time-color wording, and acquisition/visualization timestamps contain unresolved source inconsistencies.
The claim of leading all breast spatial metrics conflicts with the higher CCNet PSNR in Table 1. Ablation percentages and metric/module attribution are also unclear.
Comparator nonconvergence under shared hyperparameters limits claims of adequately tuned head-to-head superiority.
Diffusion stochasticity is not calibrated predictive uncertainty. No uncertainty decomposition, calibration study, trajectory coverage, or uncertainty-based decision rule is reported.
No quantitative error-versus-horizon criterion, tolerance-based effective horizon, or recursive drift evaluation is reported.
Anatomical invariance and smoothness are regularization priors, not identified pharmacokinetic mechanisms or causal intervention effects.
Contrast avoidance, lower costs, diagnostic reliability and clinical universality are author claims, not demonstrated patient/workflow benefits.
No actual expert reader study, prospective shadow use, prospective intervention, comparative effectiveness study, authorization, or operational monitoring is reported.

Safety guards, abstention, privacy controls, security testing, ethics approval and governance compliance are not sufficiently reported; research status does not establish their absence or inapplicability.
Code is announced in the paper. Current repository accessibility, implementation details, released weights and licensing were not checked.
References were read as bibliography entries; cited systems were not independently retrieved and their capabilities were not transferred to MRI CEKWorld.
No structural JSON Schema validator, cross-reference engine, graph assembly, regression test, or external code execution was run in this response.
